headline: Clinton order removes the Naval Special Warfare Development Group from the federal labor-management relations program.
what_it_does: This executive order takes the Naval Special Warfare Development Group, a Navy special operations unit, out of the federal program that covers labor unions and collective bargaining for government workers. As a result, federal civilian employees in this unit would not be covered by that program's union and bargaining rules. No summary was provided, so details beyond the title are limited.

who_it_affects.group: Federal civilian employees at the Naval Special Warfare Development Group
who_it_affects.how: They are excluded from the federal labor-management relations program, which covers union representation and collective bargaining.
They would no longer be able to represent or bargain for workers in this unit under the program.
